Inductive typing : tctx -> expr -> bool -> expr -> Prop :=
| TFVar Γ x l τ κ :
    Γ !! x = Some (l, τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ fvar x :{l} τ
| TUnit Γ : Γ ⊢ () :{⊥} 𝟙
| TLit Γ b : Γ ⊢ lit b :{⊥} 𝔹
| TFun Γ x l τ e :
    Σ !! x = Some (DFun (l, τ) e) ->
    Γ ⊢ gvar x :{l} τ
| TAbs Γ l1 l2 e τ1 τ2 κ L :
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l2, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e^x :{l1} τ1^x) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ \:{l2}τ2 => e :{l1} (Π:{l2}τ2, τ1)
| TLet Γ l1 l2 l e1 e2 τ1 τ2 L :
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ1 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l1, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ2^x) ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ let e1 in e2 :{l} τ2^e1
| TApp Γ l1 l2 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} (Π:{l2}τ2, τ1) ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 e2 :{l1} τ1^e2
| TPair Γ l1 l2 l e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ1 ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ2 ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ (e1, e2) :{l} τ1 * τ2
| TProj Γ l b e τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ1 * τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ π@b e :{l} ite b τ1 τ2
| TInj Γ l b e τ1 τ2 κ :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} ite b τ1 τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 + τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ inj@b<τ1 + τ2> e :{l} τ1 + τ2
| TIf Γ l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ κ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ^(lit true) ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ^(lit false) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ^e0 :: κ ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ if e0 then e1 else e2 :{l} τ^e0
| TIfNoDep Γ l0 l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{l0} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ ->
    l = l0 ⊔ l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ if e0 then e1 else e2 :{l} τ
| TCase Γ l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1 + τ2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e1^x :{l1} τ^(inl<τ1 + τ2> x)) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ^(inr<τ1 + τ2> x)) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ^e0 :: κ ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ case e0 of e1 | e2 :{l} τ^e0
| TCaseNoDep Γ l0 l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{l0} τ1 + τ2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(l0, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e1^x :{l1} τ) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(l0, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    l = l0 ⊔ l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ case e0 of e1 | e2 :{l} τ
| TFold Γ l X e τ :
    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ fold<X> e :{l} gvar X
| TUnfold Γ l X e τ :
    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} gvar X ->
    Γ ⊢ unfold<X> e :{l} τ
| TSec Γ l e :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ s𝔹 e :{l} ~𝔹
| TMux Γ e0 e1 e2 τ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} ~𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{⊥} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{⊥} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ mux e0 e1 e2 :{⊥} τ
| TOInj Γ b e τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} ite b τ1 τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 ~+ τ2 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ ~inj@b<τ1 ~+ τ2> e :{⊥} τ1 ~+ τ2
| TOIf Γ l1 l2 e0 e1 e2 τ κ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} ~𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ ~if e0 then e1 else e2 :{⊤} τ
| TOCase Γ l1 l2 e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1 ~+ τ2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e1^x :{l1} τ) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ ~case e0 of e1 | e2 :{⊤} τ
| TTape Γ l e τ :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ tape e :{⊥} τ

| TBoxedLit Γ b : Γ ⊢ [b] :{⊥} ~𝔹
| TBoxedInj Γ b v ω :
    ovalty <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }> ω ->
    Γ ⊢ [inj@b<ω> v] :{⊥} ω

| TConv Γ l l' e τ τ' κ :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l'} τ' ->
    τ' ≡ τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    l' ⊑ l ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ

with kinding : tctx -> expr -> kind -> Prop :=
| KADT Γ X τ :
    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ gvar X :: *@P
| KUnit Γ : Γ ⊢ 𝟙 :: *@A
| KBool Γ l : Γ ⊢ 𝔹{l} :: ite l *@O *@P
| KPi Γ l τ1 τ2 κ1 κ2 L :
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ τ2^x :: κ2) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ1 ->
    Γ ⊢ (Π:{l}τ1, τ2) :: *@M
| KProd Γ τ1 τ2 κ :
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 * τ2 :: κ
| KSum Γ τ1 τ2 κ :
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 + τ2 :: (κ ⊔ *@P)
| KOSum Γ τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 ~+ τ2 :: *@O
| KOADT Γ e' e τ X :
    Σ !! X = Some (DOADT τ e') ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ (gvar X) e :: *@O
| KIf Γ e0 τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ if e0 then τ1 else τ2 :: *@O
| KCase Γ e0 τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1' + τ2' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1')]>Γ ⊢ τ1^x :: *@O) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2')]>Γ ⊢ τ2^x :: *@O) ->
    Γ ⊢ case e0 of τ1 | τ2 :: *@O
| KLet Γ e τ τ' L :
    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(⊥, τ')]>Γ ⊢ τ^x :: *@O) ->
    Γ ⊢ let e in τ :: *@O
| KSub Γ τ κ κ' :
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ' ->
    κ' ⊑ κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ

where "Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" := (typing Γ e l τ)
  and "Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" := (kinding Γ τ κ)
.

    | |- lct ?kk (if decide (?kk = ?i) then ?w else EBVar ?i) =>

  all: try (repeat split).
  all: try (match goal with

  intros n. induction n as [|n IH]; intros e Hn H.
  - destruct e; cbn in *; try (exfalso; lia).
  - destruct e; cbn in *; try (exfalso; lia);
      try (repeat match goal with H : _ /\ _ |- _ => destruct H end).
    all: try (match goal with
      | |- lc (EPi ?l ?t1 ?t2) =>
          apply LCPi with (L := ∅);
          [ intros z _;
            pose proof (lct_open_fvar0 t2 z ltac:(assumption)) as Hl;
            apply (IH (open (EFVar z) t2)); [ change (esize (open_ 0 (EFVar z) t2) <= n); rewrite esize_open_fvar; lia
                      | exact Hl ]
          | apply IH; [ lia | assumption ] ]
      end).
    all: tryif (match goal with |- lc (EAbs _ _ _) => idtac end)
      then (
          apply LCAbs with (L := ∅);
          [ intros z _;
            pose proof (lct_open_fvar0 e2 z ltac:(assumption)) as Hl;
            apply (IH (open (EFVar z) e2)); [ change (esize (open_ 0 (EFVar z) e2) <= n); rewrite esize_open_fvar; lia
                      | exact Hl ]
          | apply IH; [ lia | assumption ] ]
      ) else idtac.
    all: try (match goal with
      | |- lc (ELet ?e1 ?e2) =>
          apply LCLet with (L := ∅);
          [ intros z _;
            pose proof (lct_open_fvar0 e2 z ltac:(assumption)) as Hl;
            apply (IH (open (EFVar z) e2)); [ change (esize (open_ 0 (EFVar z) e2) <= n); rewrite esize_open_fvar; lia
                      | exact Hl ]
          | apply IH; [ lia | assumption ] ]
      end).
    all: try (match goal with
      | |- lc (ECase ?l ?e0 ?e1 ?e2) =>
          apply LCCase with (L1 := ∅) (L2 := ∅);
          [ intros z _;
            pose proof (lct_open_fvar0 e1 z ltac:(assumption)) as Hl;
            apply (IH (open (EFVar z) e1)); [ change (esize (open_ 0 (EFVar z) e1) <= n); rewrite esize_open_fvar; lia
                      | exact Hl ]
          | intros z _;
            pose proof (lct_open_fvar0 e2 z ltac:(assumption)) as Hl;
            apply (IH (open (EFVar z) e2)); [ change (esize (open_ 0 (EFVar z) e2) <= n); rewrite esize_open_fvar; lia
                      | exact Hl ]
          | apply IH; [ lia | assumption ] ]
      end).
    all: try (constructor; try (apply IH; [ cbn; lia | assumption ]); try assumption).
Qed.

  | |- lc (ECase ?l ?e0 ?e1 ?e2) =>
      match goal with
      | H0 : lct 0 e0, H1 : lct 1 e1, H2 : lct 1 e2 |- _ =>
          apply LCCase with (L1 := ∅) (L2 := ∅);
          [ intros z _;
            apply IH; [ solve_size_open z e1
                      | fold lct; apply lct_open; [ apply lct0_fvar | assumption ] ]
          | intros z _;
            apply IH; [ solve_size_open z e2
                      | fold lct; apply lct_open; [ apply lct0_fvar | assumption ] ]
          | apply IH; [ lia | assumption ] ]
      end
  end.

Lemma lct0_lc_aux : forall n e, esize e <= n -> lct 0 e -> lc e.
Proof.
  intros n. induction n as [|n IH]; intros e Hn H.
  - destruct e; cbn in *; try (exfalso; lia).
  - destruct e; cbn in *; try (exfalso; lia);
      try (repeat match goal with H : _ /\ _ |- _ => destruct H end).
    all: try (match goal with
      | |- lc (EPi ?l ?t1 ?t2) =>
          apply LCPi with (L := ∅);
          [ intros z _;
            pose proof (lct_open_fvar0 t2 z ltac:(assumption)) as Hl;
            apply (IH (open (EFVar z) t2)); [ change (esize (open_ 0 (EFVar z) t2) <= n); rewrite esize_open_fvar; lia
                      | exact Hl ]
          | apply IH; [ lia | assumption ] ]
      end).
    all: tryif (match goal with |- lc (EAbs _ _ _) => idtac end)
      then (
          apply LCAbs with (L := ∅);
          [ intros z _;
            pose proof (lct_open_fvar0 e2 z ltac:(assumption)) as Hl;
            apply (IH (open (EFVar z) e2)); [ change (esize (open_ 0 (EFVar z) e2) <= n); rewrite esize_open_fvar; lia
                      | exact Hl ]
          | apply IH; [ lia | assumption ] ]
      ) else idtac.
    all: try (match goal with
      | |- lc (ELet ?e1 ?e2) =>
          apply LCLet with (L := ∅);
          [ intros z _;
            pose proof (lct_open_fvar0 e2 z ltac:(assumption)) as Hl;
            apply (IH (open (EFVar z) e2)); [ change (esize (open_ 0 (EFVar z) e2) <= n); rewrite esize_open_fvar; lia
                      | exact Hl ]
          | apply IH; [ lia | assumption ] ]
      end).
    all: try (match goal with
      | |- lc (ECase ?l ?e0 ?e1 ?e2) =>
          apply LCCase with (L1 := ∅) (L2 := ∅);
          [ intros z _;
            pose proof (lct_open_fvar0 e1 z ltac:(assumption)) as Hl;
            apply (IH (open (EFVar z) e1)); [ change (esize (open_ 0 (EFVar z) e1) <= n); rewrite esize_open_fvar; lia
                      | exact Hl ]
          | intros z _;
            pose proof (lct_open_fvar0 e2 z ltac:(assumption)) as Hl;
            apply (IH (open (EFVar z) e2)); [ change (esize (open_ 0 (EFVar z) e2) <= n); rewrite esize_open_fvar; lia
                      | exact Hl ]
          | apply IH; [ lia | assumption ] ]
      end).
    all: try (constructor; try (apply IH; [ cbn; lia | assumption ]); try assumption).
Qed.

Lemma lc_lct0 (e : expr) (H : lc e) : lct 0 e.
Proof.
  induction H using lc_ind.
  all: cbn.
  all: try (repeat split).
  all: try assumption.
  all: try (match goal with
    | I : forall z, z ∉ ?L -> lct 0 (open (EFVar z) ?b) |- lct 1 ?b =>
        idtac "ARMSTART";
        destruct (exists_fresh_atom L) as [z Hz];
        idtac "FRESH";
        eapply lct_inv_open_fvar with (kk := 0);
        idtac "APPLIED";
        apply I; exact Hz
    end).
  all: try exact I.
  all: try (split; assumption).
Qed.

Lemma lct0_lc e : lct 0 e -> lc e.
Proof. intros H. exact (lct0_lc_aux (esize e) e (le_n _) H). Qed.

Lemma lc_open_lc b w : lc b -> lc w -> lc (open w b).
Proof.
  intros Hb Hw.
  apply lct0_lc.
  apply (lct_open b 0 w).
  - apply lc_lct0; exact Hw.
  - apply (lct_mono b 0 1); [lia | apply lc_lct0; exact Hb].
Qed.

  - idtac "TUnit"; intros; cbn; try (match goal with H : lc ?e |- _ => inversion H; subst end); econstructor; eauto 3; fail.
  - idtac "TLit"; intros; cbn; try (match goal with H : lc ?e |- _ => inversion H; subst end); econstructor; eauto 3; fail.

    intros Γ x0 l τ e Hfun Hlc Hlk. cbn.

    assert (Hx : x ∉ fv τ) by (rewrite Hfvτ; set_solver).

    + apply IHk; [exact Hlcτ2 | exact Hlk].

    destruct (lc_let_inv e1 e2 Hlc) as [L0 [Hlce1 Hbody]].
    assert (Hlvc : lc v) by (apply lcv_elim; exact Hlcv).
    rewrite (subst_open_gen_o x v e1 τ2 Hlvc Hlce1).
    eapply TLet with (L := L ∪ L0 ∪ {[x]}).
    + exact (IH1 Hlce1 Hlk).
    + intros y Hy.
      assert (HyL : y ∉ L) by set_solver.
      assert (HyL0 : y ∉ L0) by set_solver.
      assert (Hyx : y <> x) by set_solver.
      assert (Hne : x <> y) by set_solver.
      assert (Hlook_y : <[y:=(l1,τ1)]>Γ !! x = Some (lv,τv)).
      { rewrite lookup_insert_ne by exact Hyx. exact Hlk. }
      assert (Hlcy : lc (open (EFVar y) e2)) by (apply Hbody; assumption).
      rewrite <- (ctx_subst_delete_insert_lex x v y l1 τ1 Γ Hyx).
      rewrite <- (subst_open_comm_o x y v e2 Hne Hlvc).
      rewrite <- (subst_open_comm_o x y v τ2 Hne Hlvc).

    + exact Heq.
  - (* TApp *)
    intros Γ l1 l2 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2 Hlc Hlk. cbn.
    assert (Hlvc : lc v) by (apply lcv_elim; exact Hlcv).
    assert (Hlce1 : lc e1) by (apply (lcEApp1 e1 e2); exact Hlc).
    assert (Hlce2 : lc e2) by (apply (lcEApp2 e1 e2); exact Hlc).
    rewrite (subst_open_gen_o x v e2 τ1 Hlvc Hlce2).

    + exact (IH1 Hlce1 Hlk).
    + exact (IH2 Hlce2 Hlk).
  - idtac "TPair"; intros; cbn; try (match goal with H : lc ?e |- _ => inversion H; subst end); econstructor; eauto 3; fail.

    assert (Hlce : lc e) by (apply (lcEProj b e); exact Hlc).

Lemma ctx_subst_delete_insert x v y U Γ (Hy : y <> x) :

Definition gctx_closed (Σ : gctx) : Prop :=
  forall y D, Σ !! y = Some D ->
    match D with
    | DADT τ => fv τ = ∅
    | DFun T e => fv (T.2) = ∅ /\ fv e = ∅
    | DOADT τ' τ => fv τ' = ∅ /\ fv τ = ∅
    end.

Lemma gctx_closed_fun Σ y l τ e : gctx_closed Σ -> Σ !! y = Some (DFun (l,τ) e) -> fv τ = ∅ /\ fv e = ∅.
Proof. intros H E. specialize (H y _ E). exact H. Qed.
Lemma gctx_closed_adt Σ y τ : gctx_closed Σ -> Σ !! y = Some (DADT τ) -> fv τ = ∅.
Proof. intros H E. specialize (H y _ E). exact H. Qed.
Lemma gctx_closed_oadt Σ y τ' τ : gctx_closed Σ -> Σ !! y = Some (DOADT τ' τ) -> fv τ' = ∅ /\ fv τ = ∅.
Proof. intros H E. specialize (H y _ E). exact H. Qed.

Lemma typing_kinding_lc Σ :

    (fun Γ e l τ => lc e)
    (fun Γ τ κ => lc τ)).
  all: try (eauto 40 with lcdb ovdb; fail).

Lemma typing_kinding_subst Σ x lv τv v :
  gctx_closed Σ ->
  Σ;∅⊢v:{lv}τv -> fv v = ∅ -> lcv v -> x ∉ fv τv ->
  (forall Γ e l τ, Σ;Γ⊢e:{l}τ -> lc e -> Γ !! x = Some (lv, τv) ->
      Σ; (ctx_subst x v (delete x Γ)) ⊢ <{ {x↦v}e }> :{l} <{ {x↦v}τ }>)
  /\ (forall Γ τ κ, Σ;Γ⊢τ::κ -> lc τ -> Γ !! x = Some (lv, τv) ->
      Σ; (ctx_subst x v (delete x Γ)) ⊢ <{ {x↦v}τ }> :: κ).
Proof.
  intros HΣ Hv Hfv Hlcv Hnf.
  apply (typing_kinding_mutind Σ
    (fun Γ e l τ => lc e -> Γ !! x = Some (lv, τv) -> Σ; (ctx_subst x v (delete x Γ)) ⊢ <{ {x↦v}e }> :{l} <{ {x↦v}τ }>)
    (fun Γ τ κ => lc τ -> Γ !! x = Some (lv, τv) -> Σ; (ctx_subst x v (delete x Γ)) ⊢ <{ {x↦v}τ }> :: κ)).
  - (* TFVar *)
    intros Γ x0 l τ κ Hl0 Hk IHk Hlc Hlk. cbn.
    case_decide as E.
    + subst x0. rewrite Hl0 in Hlk. inversion Hlk; subst.
      rewrite (fv_subst_notin x v τv Hnf).
      apply (proj1 (typing_kinding_weaken Σ) ∅ v lv τv Hv (ctx_subst x v (delete x Γ))).
      intros y U Hy. cbn in Hy. discriminate.
    + eapply TFVar with (κ := κ).
      * apply ctx_subst_lookup_Some.

Definition ctx_incl (Γ Γ' : tctx) : Prop :=
  forall x T, Γ !! x = Some T -> Γ' !! x = Some T.

Lemma ctx_incl_insert x T Γ Γ' : ctx_incl Γ Γ' -> ctx_incl (<[x:=T]>Γ) (<[x:=T]>Γ').
Proof.
  intros H y U Hy. unfold ctx_incl in *.
  destruct (decide (y = x)) as [E|E].
  - subst y. rewrite lookup_insert in Hy. rewrite lookup_insert.
    case_decide; [exact Hy|exfalso; auto].
  - assert (Hne : x <> y) by (intro; apply E; symmetry; assumption).
    rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hy by exact Hne.
    rewrite lookup_insert_ne by exact Hne.
    apply H, Hy.
Qed.

Lemma typing_kinding_weaken Σ :
  (forall Γ e l τ, Σ;Γ⊢e:{l}τ -> forall Γ', ctx_incl Γ Γ' -> Σ;Γ'⊢e:{l}τ)
  /\ (forall Γ τ κ, Σ;Γ⊢τ::κ -> forall Γ', ctx_incl Γ Γ' -> Σ;Γ'⊢τ::κ).
Proof.
  apply (typing_kinding_mutind Σ
    (fun Γ e l τ => forall Γ', ctx_incl Γ Γ' -> Σ;Γ'⊢e:{l}τ)
    (fun Γ τ κ => forall Γ', ctx_incl Γ Γ' -> Σ;Γ'⊢τ::κ)).
  all: try (intros; eauto 25 using ctx_incl_insert; fail).
  all: try (intros; econstructor; eauto 20 using ctx_incl_insert; fail).
Qed.

Definition ctx_subst (x : atom) (v : expr) (Γ : tctx) : tctx :=
  (fun T : lexpr => (T.1, subst x v T.2)) <$> Γ.

Lemma ctx_subst_lookup x v Γ i :
  (ctx_subst x v Γ) !! i = (fun T : lexpr => (T.1, subst x v T.2)) <$> (Γ !! i).
Proof. unfold ctx_subst. apply lookup_fmap. Qed.

Lemma ctx_subst_lookup_Some x v Γ i l τ :
  Γ !! i = Some (l, τ) -> (ctx_subst x v Γ) !! i = Some (l, subst x v τ).
Proof.
  intros H. rewrite ctx_subst_lookup.
  replace (Γ !! i) with (Some (l, τ)) by (symmetry; exact H). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_subst_delete x v Γ : delete x (ctx_subst x v Γ) = ctx_subst x v (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  apply map_eq. intro i. unfold ctx_subst.
  rewrite lookup_delete.
  case_decide as E.
  - subst i. rewrite lookup_fmap. rewrite lookup_delete. cbn.
    case_decide; [reflexivity|exfalso; auto].
  - rewrite lookup_fmap. rewrite lookup_fmap. rewrite lookup_delete. cbn.
    case_decide; [subst i; exfalso; auto|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma ctx_subst_insert x v y U Γ :
  ctx_subst x v (<[y:=U]>Γ) = <[y:=(U.1, subst x v U.2)]>(ctx_subst x v Γ).

Definition ctx_incl (Γ Γ' : tctx) : Prop :=
  forall x T, Γ !! x = Some T -> Γ' !! x = Some T.

Lemma ctx_incl_insert x T Γ Γ' : ctx_incl Γ Γ' -> ctx_incl (<[x:=T]>Γ) (<[x:=T]>Γ').
Proof.
  intros H y U Hy. unfold ctx_incl in *.
  destruct (decide (y = x)) as [E|E].
  - subst y. rewrite lookup_insert in Hy. rewrite lookup_insert.
    case_decide; [exact Hy|exfalso; auto].
  - assert (Hne : x <> y) by (intro; apply E; symmetry; assumption).
    rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hy by exact Hne.
    rewrite lookup_insert_ne by exact Hne.
    apply H, Hy.
Qed.

Lemma typing_kinding_weaken Σ :
  (forall Γ e l τ, Σ;Γ⊢e:{l}τ -> forall Γ', ctx_incl Γ Γ' -> Σ;Γ'⊢e:{l}τ)
  /\ (forall Γ τ κ, Σ;Γ⊢τ::κ -> forall Γ', ctx_incl Γ Γ' -> Σ;Γ'⊢τ::κ).
Proof.
  apply (typing_kinding_mutind Σ
    (fun Γ e l τ => forall Γ', ctx_incl Γ Γ' -> Σ;Γ'⊢e:{l}τ)
    (fun Γ τ κ => forall Γ', ctx_incl Γ Γ' -> Σ;Γ'⊢τ::κ)).
  all: try (intros; eauto 25 using ctx_incl_insert; fail).
  all: try (intros; econstructor; eauto 20 using ctx_incl_insert; fail).
Qed.

Definition ctx_subst (x : atom) (v : expr) (Γ : tctx) : tctx :=
  (fun T : lexpr => (T.1, subst x v T.2)) <$> Γ.

Lemma ctx_subst_lookup x v Γ i :
  (ctx_subst x v Γ) !! i = (fun T : lexpr => (T.1, subst x v T.2)) <$> (Γ !! i).
Proof. unfold ctx_subst. apply lookup_fmap. Qed.

Lemma ctx_subst_lookup_Some x v Γ i l τ :
  Γ !! i = Some (l, τ) -> (ctx_subst x v Γ) !! i = Some (l, subst x v τ).
Proof.
  intros H. rewrite ctx_subst_lookup.
  replace (Γ !! i) with (Some (l, τ)) by (symmetry; exact H). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_subst_delete x v Γ : delete x (ctx_subst x v Γ) = ctx_subst x v (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  apply map_eq. intro i. unfold ctx_subst.
  rewrite lookup_delete.
  case_decide as E.
  - subst i. rewrite lookup_fmap. rewrite lookup_delete. cbn.
    case_decide; [reflexivity|exfalso; auto].
  - rewrite lookup_fmap. rewrite lookup_fmap. rewrite lookup_delete. cbn.
    case_decide; [subst i; exfalso; auto|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma ctx_subst_insert x v y U Γ :
  ctx_subst x v (<[y:=U]>Γ) = <[y:=(U.1, subst x v U.2)]>(ctx_subst x v Γ).

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.base.
From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.syntax.
From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.semantics.
From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.typing.

Import syntax.notations.
Import semantics.notations.
Import typing.notations.

Implicit Types (b : bool) (x X y Y : atom) (L : aset).

Fixpoint fv (e : expr) : aset :=
  match e with
  | EBVar _ | EGVar _ | EUnitT | EUnitV | ELit _ | EBool _ | EBoxedLit _ => ∅
  | EFVar x => {[x]}
  | EProd e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | ESum _ e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EPi _ e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EAbs _ e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EApp e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | ELet e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EIte _ e0 e1 e2 => fv e0 ∪ fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EPair e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EProj _ e => fv e
  | EInj _ _ e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | ECase _ e0 e1 e2 => fv e0 ∪ fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EFold _ e => fv e
  | EUnfold _ e => fv e
  | ESec e => fv e
  | ETape e => fv e
  | EMux e0 e1 e2 => fv e0 ∪ fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EBoxedInj _ _ _ => ∅
  end.

Definition closed (e : expr) : Prop := fv e = ∅.

Ltac inst_nats n :=
  repeat match goal with H : forall m : nat, _ |- _ =>
    let A := fresh in let B := fresh in
    pose proof (H n) as A; pose proof (H (S n)) as B; clear H end.

Ltac inst_exprs s :=
  repeat match goal with H : forall s0 : expr, _ |- _ =>
    let A := fresh in pose proof (H s) as A; clear H end.

Lemma fv_open n s e : fv (open_ n s e) ⊆ fv e ∪ fv s.
Proof.
  revert n. induction e; intros n; cbn; try inst_nats n;
    try set_solver; try (case_decide; set_solver).
Qed.

Lemma fv_subst x s e : fv (subst x s e) ⊆ (fv e ∖ {[x]}) ∪ fv s.
Proof. revert s. induction e; intros s; cbn; try inst_exprs s;
    try set_solver; try (case_decide; set_solver). Qed.
